# PR #5073: Patch: a motion and glow budget, idle effects only on what the player can act on

Closes #5014

## What changed

The client now has a motion and glow budget. An endless loop marks only what the player can act on right now, the main button is a flat plate, and the menus lost about a quarter of their one-off surfaces. Everything is covered by ruling R5014000.

- **Loops end (step 1).** In the 27 "loops" sheets, `infinite alternate` became `2 alternate` (one out-and-back that ends at rest), `infinite reverse` became `1 reverse`, and any other `infinite` became `1`. Three loops stay: `end-turn-ready-pulse`, `drag-reticle-pulse` and `cf-immersive-breathe`. `game/animations.css`, the cosmetic sheets and the loops in clock, highlights, lanePick, tutorial and `dungeon/map/run.css` are untouched.
- **Effects keep their timing (step 2).** A new constant, `FX_LAUNCH_FLICKER_MS = 110`, and two new custom properties set in `fx/dom.ts` (`--fx-flicker`, `--fx-flickers`) make the launch flame flicker until its cue ends instead of forever. The cinematic spark now turns 12 times, and the shield pulse and hindered glint play `2 alternate`.
- **The guard (step 3).** `compositor-loops.test.ts` gains the R5014000 tests:
  - `IDLE_LOOPS` names the 12 loops allowed to run while nothing happens, each with the state it marks; `IDLE_LOOPS_CEILING` is 12.
  - `COSMETIC_SHEETS`, `COSMETIC_LOOPS` and `PICTURE_LOOPS` hold the exemptions.
  - `strayLoops` fails on any other endless loop outside the cosmetic sheets, and a second test fails on any rule that says `infinite` without one of the listed names.
- **Primary button (step 4).** Each face is a two-stop gradient. The shadow is one inset highlight plus one hard bottom edge, with no blur. A new test in `buttons.test.ts` checks this; its helpers are tested too.
- **Surfaces (step 6).** `UNTOKENED_SURFACES` falls from 1,063 to **794**, and no entry rose (`notfound.css` reached zero and was removed). `UNTOKENED_SURFACES_CEILING = 797` has its own test. The colour counts in `UNMIGRATED` (palette.test.ts) fell in 19 sheets and were lowered to match.
- **Spec (step 7):**
  - New: `spec/rulings/R5014000.md` and `spec/pending/5014.md`.
  - A new paragraph in §10.10.
  - Amendment lines on R3608000, R3345000, R2111000, R3607000 and R3334000.
- **Docs and fragment (steps 8–9).** A paragraph in `apps/web/README.md`, and `crates/cards/patches/pending/motion-and-glow-budget.json` with `visual: true` and a hand-written player note ("A calmer table").

## How I tested it

- **Web unit suite, all 805 files**, in two runs because one full run took too long here:
  - 134 files that read the changed stylesheets: 3,256 tests pass.
  - The other 671 files: 11,474 pass, 177 skipped (skips that were already in the suite).
  - An earlier single full run under heavy load was stopped at 30 minutes. Of the failures it showed, two were real and are fixed (below). The rest were timeouts, and those files pass when run on their own.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: clean. `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`: exit 0, after I fixed two regexp lint errors in my new buttons test.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: `2660 rulings, 6502 proofs, 79209 citations in 5034 files, 36172 links: ok`.
- `cargo jackioh patches check`: ok.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: prints `classify: Cards, micro / how cards look changed`, exit 0. Classify only reads commits, so I ran it with `--head` on a commit object built from the working tree (`git commit-tree` with a temporary index). HEAD and the branch were not touched.
- `grep -rn infinite --include=*.css apps/web/src | grep -v cards/cosmetics.css | wc -l` prints **42**, not the plan's 40. The plan's count left out the 2 loops in `emotes/portrait.css`, which is a cosmetic sheet it also said not to touch.
- **Component specs (Cypress).** The full run takes about 2.5 hours here, so I stopped it after 13 specs and then ran 9 focused specs (keyword-visuals, rematch-buttons, rarity-marks, card-fullscreen, emotes-layout, card-versions, mobile-ux, anomaly-moments, art-answers).
  - Everything passes except two specs: anomaly-moments (R3337002, the `[data-fx="rays"]` cue never appears) and art-answers (R3340000/R3350000, the press flinch).
  - Both fail the same way on an unmodified `main` (62f270a22d) in a temporary worktree here, which I then removed. I have no CI run on `main` to link, since component specs only run daily.
- **Not run locally:** `e2e smoke` and the Rust suites (no Rust changed). The harness and CI run them.
- `e2e/` has no pixel baselines, so there was nothing to re-record.

## Decisions the plan did not settle

1. **Coloured glows are deleted, not turned into a black shadow.** A blurred layer with a non-neutral colour (e.g. `0 0 8px var(--tier)`) was removed; only black or tavern-night drops became `--shadow-N`. The rejected option, the plan's mapping, would have turned a coloured glow into a black drop shadow.
2. **Shadow token by blur plus spread, nearest token** (≤7 → `--shadow-1`, ≤24 → `--shadow-2`, else `--shadow-3`). The plan's thresholds (≤4, ≤16) would have made subtle negative-spread shadows like `0 12px 24px -16px` into the heaviest token.
3. **Glows that carry information keep theirs:** pack-slot rarity, the bursting fill bar, the Duos ping marker and portal flash. They are still counted.
4. **Gradients that draw a value are skipped:** the settings slider's fill and the lobby radio's checked dot. Flattening them would erase the value they show.
5. **Two flattened colours are not the last stop.** The practice result title (gradient text) became `var(--glow)`; its last stop is the dark rim and would sink into the dialog. The landing's main CTA became `var(--tavern-gold)`; its last stop gives about 3.8:1 contrast with its ink.
6. **Two more rulings amended:** R3607000 (keyword loops) and R3334000 (shipyard idle). Their text said these loop, and they no longer do.
7. **Two tests that pinned old values were updated:** `PatchNotes.test.tsx` pinned `z-index: 3`, now `var(--z-overlay)` (same pixels). The S2 table in `fx/constants.test.ts` gained `FX_LAUNCH_FLICKER_MS`.
8. **Black Hole breath and the full-screen view's camera play out and back once**, as the plan's file list asked. Keeping either would need a place in `IDLE_LOOPS`, and all 12 are taken.

## Worth a second look

- Step 6 was applied by a script, so the visual diff in `routes/landing.css`, `practice/practice.css`, `game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css` and `auth/tavern.css` deserves a skim. Inset shadows on inputs and wells are gone, and a few `::before`/`::after` fades are deleted.

- After their one run, loaders (spinners, search ping, skeleton sheen, AI thinking orb) rest still, as the plan's open question accepted.

# #5014: Patch: a motion and glow budget, idle effects only on what the player can act on
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

The client's stylesheets hold:

- 678 `@keyframes` (339 in `fx/fx.css`, 64 in `game/animations.css`, 41 in `cards/keywords.css`)
- 1,044 gradients
- 466 box-shadows, 74 text-shadows and 57 `drop-shadow` filters

When everything shines, nothing tells the player where to look. The main button (`--primary-face` in `buttons.css`) is a four-stop gradient under three shadows: the glossy look of a generic game UI kit.

- An idle, `infinite` animation marks only what the player can act on right now: playable cards in hand, legal attackers and targets, the End Turn button when ending the turn is the only move, and the turn timer's warning. Everything else loops at most once, or not at all.

- Flatten the main button: a face with at most two stops, one inset top highlight and one hard bottom edge, so it reads as a pressed brass plate rather than gel.
- Cut gradients and blurred shadows on chrome and menus, keeping those on card faces, the table and `GRADIENT_KEEP`.
- A cosmetic a player owns (`cards/cosmetics.css` and the effects a cosmetic names) keeps its look.
